name: 7-Eleven Combined Distribution Center Austin TX (E.A. Sween)

fieldNotes.facility: 8606 Wall St is a multi-tenant tilt-wall warehouse in the Prologis Walnut Creek Business Park; E.A. Sween operates a 7-Eleven Combined Distribution Center (CDC, fresh-food cross-dock) from Suite 450. The audited footprint is the central two-building cluster sharing an open truck court; other suites (e.g. CEVA) share the same court.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (pano dqmsaKkN-jISlA27mXq8QA, 2022-04) and satellite show driveways opening directly onto Wall St with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point. Open business-park access.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth anywhere at the entrances; only a decorative stone monument pillar and some low metal fence panels along the road edge, not a guard checkpoint.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate present, so no remote check-in.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Approach from Wall St into the shared truck court is short (1-2 trucks) before reaching dock face.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single open court serves both inbound and outbound truck movements; uncontrolled.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Rear-load dock wall on the court-facing (SW) face of the central building shows ~12-18 doors with trailers/box trucks backed in; the full multi-tenant block could reach 25-50 across both dock walls. Banded conservatively at 10-25 for the audited building face.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A handful of trailers (CEVA-branded) parked at/near dock doors in the shared court; no marked stand-alone trailer stalls. 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot separate from active docks; trailers sit at the dock apron.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two large buildings frame the truck court, but the tenant occupies one suite in a shared park rather than a single-occupant campus; set false. Flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Austin industrial fabric inside the 700-acre Walnut Creek Business District, near US-183/US-290/I-35. Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur on or into the parcel.
